description: Erection of outbuilding to the rear of 7 Blenkarne Road to serve a pool and garden store with solar panels to the roof.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed: 000A Rev. P1, 000B Rev. P1, 000C Rev. P1, 000D Rev. P1, 012 Rev. P1, 013 Rev. P1, 210 Rev. P2, 
211 Rev. P2, 300 Rev. P1, Biodiversity Net Gain Statement prepared by Redstone Ecology (dated 20th April 2025, Ref: RSE_LT0620_JP Rev B), RSE 620_R04_Ecological Technical Note - Further Ecological Information prepared by Redstone Ecology, BS 5837:2012 Arboricultural Report, Impact Assessment and Method Statement (dated May 2026, Ref: Version: V1.8, Ref: BS/984), Construction Traffic Management Plan prepared by Dee5 Ltd (dated February 2026), Flood Risk Assessment & Preliminary Sustainable Drainage System Strategy prepared by STM Environmental Consultants Ltd (dated 8th January 2026, Ref: FRASW - 2025 - 000035), Heritage Statement prepared by Pegasus Group (dated 9th February 2026, Ref: P24-2123), Reasonable Exception Statement (Fire Safety- 7 Blenkarne Road) 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be strictly carried out in accordance with the materials and finishes specified on approved drawings titled 210 Rev. P2 and 211 Rev. P2 and thereafter so retained. 
Reason: In the interests of the appearance of the locality and surrounding Conservation Area, in accordance with Council policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved BS 5837:2012 Arboricultural Report, Impact Assessment and Method Statement (dated May 2026, Ref: Version: V1.8, Ref: BS/984), including the protective measures and working methods identified therein, as shown on associated drawings within Appendix 3: Figure 3: Tree Constraints Plan (TCP984-a-ARB-01 Rev. A), Figure 4: Tree Impacts Plan (TIP984-b-ARB-02 Rev. D), Figure 5: Tree Protection Plan TPP984-d-ARB-03 Rev. E and Figure 6: Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS984-d-ARB-04 Rev. E], unless otherwise agreed in writing. The protection measures shall be retained until completion of the development. 
Reason: To preserve trees on the site in the interests of visual amenity and to preserve character of the area of the Conservation Area, in accordance with Council policies LP3 and LP56 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall not be used or occupied until details of replacement tree planting have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the number, species, size, location and planting specification of all replacement trees. The approved planting shall be carried out in the first planting season following occupation of the development and trees which within a period of five years from the date of planting die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To mitigate the loss of trees and ensure the satisfactory appearance and landscaping of the site, in accordance with Policies LP1 and LP56 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first operation of any fixed plant, machinery or mechanical equipment associated with the development, details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that the rating level of noise emitted from the plant shall be at least 5Db(a) below the existing background level (LA90,T) when measured at the nearest noise-sensitive receptors. The assessment shall be undertaken in accordance BS 4142. The approved plant and any associated mitigation measures shall be installed in full prior to first operation and shall thereafter be retained and maintained as approved. 
Reason: To safeguard the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers from noise disturbance, in accordance with Council Policies LP2 and LP5 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 7 - Prior to first use of the development hereby approved, the sustainable drainage measures detailed in the approved Flood Risk Assessment & Preliminary Sustainable Drainage System Strategy prepared by STM Environmental Consultants Ltd (dated 8th January 2026, Ref: FRASW - 2025 - 000035), shall be fully implemented and thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: To ensure satisfactory surface water drainage and reduce flood risk, in accordance with Council policy LP12 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 8 - The construction of the development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved Construction Traffic Management Plan prepared by Dee5 Ltd (dated February 2026) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved measures shall be implemented for the full duration of excavation and construction works. 
Reason: To minimise disruption to the surrounding highway network and to safeguard the amenities of the area, in accordance with Council policies LP50 and LP51 coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 9 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be used solely for purposes incidental to the residential use and enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 7 Blenkarne Road SW11 6HZ and shall not be used or occupied as a separate self-contained dwelling, short-term letting, commercial use, business use, or any other purpose independent of the host dwellinghouse. 
Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains incidental to the host dwellinghouse, to safeguard the residential character of the area and neighbouring amenity, and to prevent the creation of a new unit of accommodation without proper assessment, in accordance with Policies LP1, LP2, LP3, LP5 and LP51 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023). 

Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
